notes.title: Release v1.0.4
notes.notes: [h2]Enhancements[/h2][list][*][p]Made two achievements related to submitting incorrect solutions easier to obtain.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Bugfixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where players who transferred their save data over from the demo were unable to obtain some achievements.[/p][list][*][p]If you’ve met the requirements for these achievements, you should receive them upon entering the main menu.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fixed some instruments playing in the Powerplant song when they shouldn’t.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Release v1.0.3
notes.notes: [h2]Enhancements[/h2][list][*][p]Enabled V-Sync to fix screen tearing. (This forces the frame rate to be the highest-supported by your monitor, so the FPS Mode toggle in the System Settings has been removed.)[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the default keyboard bindings for the Reset Grid input action to include the R key.[/p][list][*][p]If you’ve used a previous version, press the [b]Reset Keyboard Configuration[/b] button in the Controls Settings to get this change.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Improved the way the game handles switching or disconnecting controllers while in the middle of input rebinding.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Bugfixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where submitting an incorrect solution directly after a correct one could cause the incorrect solution to be shown as correct.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some visuals issues that occurred if you made certain inputs extremely quickly after a correct solution was displayed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed being able to leave the Controls Settings or select elements with the mouse while in the middle of input rebinding.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a visual issue with the back button when trying to leave the Controls Settings while a required input binding is missing.   [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a visual issue with the balloons in Suburbs.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][/h2][p][/p][p][/p]
